gold_sql: SELECT dischargedatetime AS discharge_time FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10000032 AND dischargedatetime LIKE '2100-08%' ORDER BY discharge_time;

instruction: Your goal is to find if a specific procedure was performed on a patient. You are interested in patient ID 10021118 and you want to know whether a saphenous vein stripping was performed using a percutaneous endoscopic approach. If a record of this procedure exists, you want to know the most recent procedure time. If it does not exist, end the conversation.
gold_sql: SELECT ap.recordeddatetime FROM admissionprocedures ap JOIN hospitaladmissions ha ON ap.admissionid = ha.admissionid JOIN procedurecodes pc ON ap.icdcode = pc.icdcode AND ap.codeversion = pc.codeversion WHERE ha.patientid = 10021118 AND pc.description LIKE '%saphenous vein%' AND pc.description LIKE '%percutaneous endoscopic%' ORDER BY ap.recordeddatetime DESC LIMIT 1;

instruction: Your goal is to investigate the relationship between morphine administration and subsequent vital signs. Specifically, you want to know what percentage of cases where morphine was administered during a hospital stay meet this condition: their minimum respiratory rate within 6 hours after the morphine administration is lower than their last respiratory rate measured within 1 hour before the morphine administration. For the total cases, you want to include hospital records that involve morphine administration, with the respiratory rate measured within 1 hour before the morphine administration and at least one respiratory rate measurement within 6 hours after the morphine administration. You want to know the number of cases, not the number of patients, under such conditions. You want the result in percentage (%). You want the morphine data from patient input records, not prescription records.
gold_sql: WITH MorphineAdmin AS ( SELECT ir.patientid, ir.admissionid, ir.startdatetime, ir.itemcode FROM intakerecords ir JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ir.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE LOWER(cit.itemname) LIKE '%morphine%' ), PreMorphineRR AS ( SELECT ma.patientid, ma.admissionid, ma.startdatetime, MAX(ce.recordeddatetime) as last_pre_datetime, ce.value as pre_rr FROM MorphineAdmin ma JOIN clinicalevents ce ON ma.patientid = ce.patientid AND ma.admissionid = ce.admissionid JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ce.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE cit.itemname LIKE '%respiratory rate%' AND ce.recordeddatetime <= ma.startdatetime AND ce.recordeddatetime >= datetime(ma.startdatetime, '-1 hour') AND ce.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.patientid, ma.admissionid, ma.startdatetime ), PostMorphineRR AS ( SELECT ma.patientid, ma.admissionid, ma.startdatetime, MIN(ce.value) as min_post_rr FROM MorphineAdmin ma JOIN clinicalevents ce ON ma.patientid = ce.patientid AND ma.admissionid = ce.admissionid JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ce.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE cit.itemname LIKE '%respiratory rate%' AND ce.recordeddatetime >= ma.startdatetime AND ce.recordeddatetime <= datetime(ma.startdatetime, '+6 hours') AND ce.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.patientid, ma.admissionid, ma.startdatetime ), ValidCases AS ( SELECT pre.pre_rr, post.min_post_rr FROM PreMorphineRR pre JOIN PostMorphineRR post ON pre.patientid = post.patientid ), CasesWithLowerRR AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) as lower_rr_count FROM ValidCases WHERE min_post_rr < pre_rr ) SELECT ROUND( (SELECT lower_rr_count FROM CasesWithLowerRR) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ValidCases), 4 ) as percentage_lower_rr

instruction: Your goal is to find out the number of patients. Specifically, you want to know how many elderly patients are still admitted to the hospital. You want to define elderly patients as those aged 65 and older. If the database contains age information at the time of admission, you want to use that information directly rather than calculating the age.
gold_sql: WITH CurrentAdmissions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT patientid FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE age >= 65 AND dischargedatetime IS NULL ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS elderly_patients_admitted FROM CurrentAdmissions;

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to patient lab tests. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10002495 and you want to know the names of all lab tests conducted during the June hospital admission. You want to initially request the results and ultimately know the results limited to the tests performed on the day of that hospital admission.
gold_sql: WITH JuneAdmissions AS ( SELECT admissionid, DATE(admitdatetime) AS admission_date FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10002495 AND admitdatetime LIKE '2100-06%' ), LabTestsOnAdmission AS ( SELECT lt.itemname AS test_name, lr.resultdatetime, lr.resultvalue, lr.resultunit FROM labresults lr JOIN labtesttypes lt ON lr.itemcode = lt.itemcode JOIN JuneAdmissions ja ON lr.admissionid = ja.admissionid WHERE DATE(lr.resultdatetime) = ja.admission_date ) SELECT test_name FROM LabTestsOnAdmission;

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to the microbiological testing of a patient. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10020944 and you want to know which bacteria were identified in the culture tests performed within 48 hours of the patient's admission.
gold_sql: WITH LatestAdmission AS ( SELECT admissionid, admitdatetime FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10020944 ORDER BY admitdatetime DESC LIMIT 1 ), MicrobialTests AS ( SELECT m.organismname, m.collecteddatetime FROM microbiologyresults m JOIN LatestAdmission la ON m.admissionid = la.admissionid WHERE datetime(m.collecteddatetime) BETWEEN datetime(la.admitdatetime) AND datetime(la.admitdatetime, '+2 days') AND m.organismname IS NOT NULL AND m.organismname != '' ) SELECT DISTINCT organismname AS bacteria_detected FROM MicrobialTests;

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to a patient’s diagnosis. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10004733 and you want to know how many days have passed since the patient was diagnosed with cerebral artery occlusion during the current hospital admission. If the patient has multiple records of the same diagnosis, you want to know the number of days elapsed since the earliest diagnosis. You want diagnosis names containing "cerebral artery occlusion."
gold_sql: WITH CurrentAdmission AS ( SELECT admissionid, admitdatetime FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10004733 AND dischargedatetime IS NULL ORDER BY admitdatetime DESC LIMIT 1 ), EarliestDiagnosis AS ( SELECT MIN(ad.recordeddatetime) AS earliest_recordeddatetime FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion JOIN CurrentAdmission ca ON ad.admissionid = ca.admissionid WHERE dc.description LIKE '%cerebral artery occlusion%' ) SELECT ROUND(JULIANDAY('2100-12-31 23:59:00') - JULIANDAY(earliest_recordeddatetime), 4) AS days_since_diagnosis FROM EarliestDiagnosis;

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to patient demographics. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10004457 and you want to know the patient's marital status.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT hospitaladmissions.maritalstatus FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE hospitaladmissions.patientid = 10004457;

instruction: Your goal is to find statistics on patient input events. Specifically, you want to know what percentage of total input events this month is accounted for by the top five most frequently administered fluids and medications in hospital admissions, all combined. If multiple results tie for the same rank among the top frequent ranks, you want to retrieve all of them. You want the result in percentage (%). You want the data from patient input records, not prescription records.
gold_sql: WITH drug_counts AS ( SELECT c.itemname AS drug_label, COUNT(*) AS admin_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM intakerecords i JOIN clinicalitemtypes c ON i.itemcode = c.itemcode WHERE datetime(i.startdatetime, 'start of month') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of month') GROUP BY c.itemname ), top_drugs AS ( SELECT SUM(admin_count) AS top_drug_count FROM drug_counts WHERE rank <= 5 ), total_count AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_admin_count FROM intakerecords WHERE datetime(startdatetime, 'start of month') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of month') ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT top_drug_count FROM top_drugs) / (SELECT total_admin_count FROM total_count), 4);

instruction: Your goal is to find diagnoses recorded after a specific procedure. Specifically, you want to identify the top three new diagnoses within 90 days after patients received electroconvulsive therapy. When querying the DB agent, since you do not know how electroconvulsive therapy is stored, use common terms like "ECT" when referring to it, and let the DB agent find it for you. You want only diagnoses newly identified after ECT. If multiple results tie for the same rank among the top frequent ranks, you want to retrieve all of them. If a patient has multiple records of ECT across hospital admissions, you only want the first ECT record among them. If a patient has multiple records of the same diagnosis name, you want to count them only once per patient.
gold_sql: WITH FirstECTProcedures AS ( SELECT ap.patientid, ap.admissionid, ap.recordeddatetime AS ect_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ap.patientid ORDER BY ap.recordeddatetime) AS rn FROM admissionprocedures ap JOIN procedurecodes pc ON ap.icdcode = pc.icdcode AND ap.codeversion = pc.codeversion WHERE pc.description = 'other electroshock therapy' ), FirstECT AS ( SELECT patientid, admissionid, ect_time FROM FirstECTProcedures WHERE rn = 1 ), PostECTDiagnoses AS ( SELECT DISTINCT fe.patientid, dc.description AS diagnosis_name FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion JOIN FirstECT fe ON ad.patientid = fe.patientid WHERE datetime(ad.recordeddatetime) BETWEEN datetime(fe.ect_time) AND datetime(fe.ect_time, '+90 days') EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT ad.patientid, dc.description AS diagnosis_name FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion JOIN FirstECT fe ON ad.patientid = fe.patientid WHERE ad.recordeddatetime < fe.ect_time ), DiagnosisCounts AS ( SELECT diagnosis_name, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM PostECTDiagnoses GROUP BY diagnosis_name ) SELECT diagnosis_name FROM DiagnosisCounts WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank;

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to new prescriptions for a patient. You are interested in patient ID 10004733 and you want to know which medications, if any, have a new prescription order started today compared to yesterday.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT medicationname FROM medicationorders WHERE patientid = 10004733 AND datetime(startdatetime, 'start of day') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of day', '-0 day') EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT medicationname FROM medicationorders WHERE patientid = 10004733 AND datetime(startdatetime, 'start of day') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of day', '-1 day');

instruction: Your goal is to find the hospitalization statistics. Specifically, you want to know how many patients are currently admitted and have not yet been discharged from the hospital. You want to order this result first. Ultimately, you want to limit the results to only those patients whose length of stay is 7 days or more.
gold_sql: WITH CurrentAdmissions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT patientid, admitdatetime, (JULIANDAY('2100-12-31 23:59:00') - JULIANDAY(admitdatetime)) AS days_admitted FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE dischargedatetime IS NULL ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS long_stay_patients FROM CurrentAdmissions WHERE days_admitted >= 7;

instruction: Your goal is to find sudden changes in patients' vital signs. Specifically, you want to find the admissionid of all patients who had their heart rate increase by 10% or more and their SpO2 drop below 90, all occurring within a 5-minute period during the same hospital admission.
gold_sql: WITH HeartRateEvents AS (SELECT c.recordid, c.admissionid, c.recordeddatetime, c.value AS heart_rate FROM clinicalevents c JOIN clinicalitemtypes di ON c.itemcode = di.itemcode WHERE di.itemname = 'heart rate' AND c.value IS NOT NULL), SpO2Events AS (SELECT c.recordid, c.admissionid, c.recordeddatetime, c.value AS spo2 FROM clinicalevents c JOIN clinicalitemtypes di ON c.itemcode = di.itemcode WHERE di.itemname = 'o2 saturation pulseoxymetry' AND c.value IS NOT NULL), VitalChanges AS (SELECT hr1.admissionid, hr1.heart_rate AS hr_start, hr2.heart_rate AS hr_end, sp2.spo2 AS spo2_end, hr1.recordeddatetime AS start_time FROM HeartRateEvents hr1 JOIN HeartRateEvents hr2 ON hr1.admissionid = hr2.admissionid LEFT JOIN SpO2Events sp1 ON hr1.admissionid = sp1.admissionid AND sp1.recordeddatetime = hr1.recordeddatetime JOIN SpO2Events sp2 ON hr2.admissionid = sp2.admissionid AND sp2.recordeddatetime = hr2.recordeddatetime WHERE datetime(hr2.recordeddatetime) BETWEEN datetime(hr1.recordeddatetime) AND datetime(hr1.recordeddatetime, '+5 minutes') AND hr2.heart_rate >= hr1.heart_rate * 1.1 AND spo2_end < 90) SELECT admissionid FROM VitalChanges;

instruction: Your goal is to find statistics on a specific surgery. Specifically, you are interested in the endoscopic removal of material from the lower lung lobe and want to know the number of patients who have undergone this surgery at least twice.
gold_sql: WITH HepatectomyPatients AS ( SELECT ap.patientid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.recordid) AS hepatectomy_count FROM admissionprocedures ap JOIN procedurecodes pc ON ap.icdcode = pc.icdcode AND ap.codeversion = pc.codeversion WHERE (pc.description LIKE '%extirpation of matter from%' AND pc.description LIKE '%lower lung lobe%') GROUP BY ap.patientid ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM HepatectomyPatients WHERE hepatectomy_count >= 2;

instruction: Your goal is to find statistics related to patient mortality. Specifically, you want to know the average age at admission of patients who died this year. If the database contains age information at the time of admission, you want to use that information directly without calculating the age. You want to count each patient's age only once.
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(h.age) AS average_age FROM demographics d JOIN ( SELECT patientid, age FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE (patientid, admitdatetime) IN ( SELECT patientid, MAX(admitdatetime) FROM hospitaladmissions GROUP BY patientid ) ) h ON d.patientid = h.patientid WHERE d.dateofdeath LIKE '2100%';

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to microbiology tests conducted under specific conditions. Specifically, you want to identify the admissionid of patients who had a microbiology test performed within 72 hours after the start of a vancomycin prescription during the same hospital admission.
gold_sql: WITH VancomycinPrescriptions AS ( SELECT mo.admissionid, mo.startdatetime FROM medicationorders mo WHERE mo.medicationname LIKE '%vancomycin%' AND mo.startdatetime IS NOT NULL ), MicrobiologyTests AS ( SELECT DISTINCT mr.admissionid FROM microbiologyresults mr JOIN VancomycinPrescriptions vp ON mr.admissionid = vp.admissionid WHERE datetime(mr.collecteddatetime) BETWEEN datetime(vp.startdatetime) AND datetime(vp.startdatetime, '+72 hours') AND mr.collecteddatetime IS NOT NULL ) SELECT admissionid FROM MicrobiologyTests;

instruction: Your goal is to find sudden changes in patients' vital signs. Specifically, you want to identify the admissionid of patients whose body temperature increased by 1°C or more within a 1-hour period during their hospital stay.
gold_sql: WITH TemperatureEvents AS ( SELECT c.admissionid, c.patientid, c.recordeddatetime AS charttime, c.value AS temperature, a.admitdatetime, a.dischargedatetime FROM clinicalevents c JOIN clinicalitemtypes di ON c.itemcode = di.itemcode JOIN hospitaladmissions a ON c.admissionid = a.admissionid WHERE di.itemname = 'temperature celsius' AND c.value IS NOT NULL AND c.recordeddatetime >= a.admitdatetime AND (c.recordeddatetime <= a.dischargedatetime OR a.dischargedatetime IS NULL) ), TempChanges AS ( SELECT t1.admissionid, t1.charttime AS start_time, t2.charttime AS end_time, t2.temperature - t1.temperature AS temp_change FROM TemperatureEvents t1 JOIN TemperatureEvents t2 ON t1.admissionid = t2.admissionid WHERE datetime(t2.charttime) BETWEEN datetime(t1.charttime) AND datetime(t1.charttime, '+1 hour') ) SELECT DISTINCT admissionid FROM TempChanges WHERE temp_change >= 1;

instruction: Your goal is to find patients with specific vital sign conditions. Specifically, you want to know the admissionid of patients in hospital admission records who have had an SpO2 continuously <90% for 15 minutes. If the interval between the next measurements is 15 minutes or longer, you want to consider the next consecutive vital sign record. You want the results to include patients currently admitted to the hospital.
gold_sql: WITH SpO2Events AS ( SELECT c.admissionid, c.patientid, c.recordeddatetime AS charttime, c.value AS spo2 FROM clinicalevents c JOIN clinicalitemtypes di ON c.itemcode = di.itemcode JOIN hospitaladmissions a ON c.admissionid = a.admissionid WHERE di.itemname = 'o2 saturation pulseoxymetry' AND c.value IS NOT NULL AND c.value < 90 ), ContinuousSpO2 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT s1.admissionid FROM SpO2Events s1 JOIN SpO2Events s2 ON s1.admissionid = s2.admissionid WHERE s2.charttime > s1.charttime AND (strftime('%s', s2.charttime) - strftime('%s', s1.charttime)) >= 900 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinicalevents c3 JOIN clinicalitemtypes di3 ON c3.itemcode = di3.itemcode WHERE di3.itemname = 'o2 saturation pulseoxymetry' AND c3.admissionid = s1.admissionid AND c3.recordeddatetime > s1.charttime AND c3.recordeddatetime < s2.charttime AND c3.value IS NOT NULL AND c3.value >= 90 ) ) SELECT admissionid FROM ContinuousSpO2;

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to patient admissions. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10000032 and want to know how many times they were admitted to the hospital in August of this year.
gold_sql: WITH AugustAdmissions AS ( SELECT admissionid FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10000032 AND admitdatetime LIKE '2100-08%' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT admissionid) AS admission_count FROM AugustAdmissions;

instruction: Your goal is to find statistics related to patient readmissions. Specifically, you want to know the number of patients diagnosed with congestive heart failure who were readmitted to the hospital within 30 days of discharge. You want to count the number of unique patients. You want diagnosis names containing "congestive heart failure."
gold_sql: WITH CHFAdmissions AS ( SELECT ad.patientid, ad.admissionid, ha.admitdatetime, ha.dischargedatetime, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ha.patientid ORDER BY ha.admitdatetime) AS admission_rank FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion JOIN hospitaladmissions ha ON ad.admissionid = ha.admissionid WHERE dc.description LIKE '%congestive heart failure%' ), AllAdmissions AS ( SELECT patientid, admissionid, admitdatetime, dischargedatetime, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY patientid ORDER BY admitdatetime) AS admission_rank FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid IN ( SELECT patientid FROM CHFAdmissions ) ), Readmissions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.patientid FROM CHFAdmissions c JOIN AllAdmissions a ON c.patientid = a.patientid WHERE a.admission_rank = c.admission_rank + 1 AND datetime(a.admitdatetime) BETWEEN datetime(c.dischargedatetime) AND datetime(c.dischargedatetime, '+30 days') ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS readmission_patients FROM Readmissions;

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to drug orders. Specifically, you want to know how many prescriptions for fentanyl patches were ordered in 2100.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medicationorders WHERE medicationorders.medicationname = 'fentanyl patch' AND datetime(medicationorders.startdatetime, 'start of year') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of year');

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to specific patient procedures. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10016742 and want to know which procedures were newly performed during their last hospital admission compared to previous admissions.
gold_sql: WITH LatestAdmission AS ( SELECT admissionid, admitdatetime FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10016742 ORDER BY admitdatetime DESC LIMIT 1 ), PriorAdmissions AS ( SELECT admissionid FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10016742 AND admitdatetime < (SELECT admitdatetime FROM LatestAdmission) ), PriorProcedures AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.codeversion, p.icdcode FROM admissionprocedures p JOIN PriorAdmissions pa ON p.admissionid = pa.admissionid ), NewProcedures AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dp.description AS procedure_name FROM admissionprocedures p JOIN procedurecodes dp ON p.icdcode = dp.icdcode AND p.codeversion = dp.codeversion JOIN LatestAdmission la ON p.admissionid = la.admissionid WHERE (p.codeversion, p.icdcode) NOT IN ( SELECT codeversion, icdcode FROM PriorProcedures ) ) SELECT procedure_name FROM NewProcedures;

instruction: Your goal is to find patient vital sign information. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10004733 and want to know how many times SpO2 was measured at 90% or lower within the first 24 hours following their current hospital admission.
gold_sql: WITH LatestAdmission AS ( SELECT admissionid, admitdatetime FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10004733 AND dischargedatetime IS NULL ORDER BY admitdatetime DESC LIMIT 1 ), SpO2Measurements AS ( SELECT ce.value AS spo2, ce.recordeddatetime FROM clinicalevents ce JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ce.itemcode = cit.itemcode JOIN LatestAdmission la ON ce.admissionid = la.admissionid WHERE ce.patientid = 10004733 AND cit.itemname = 'o2 saturation pulseoxymetry' AND ce.value IS NOT NULL AND datetime(ce.recordeddatetime) BETWEEN datetime(la.admitdatetime) AND datetime(la.admitdatetime, '+24 hours') ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS spo2_below_90_count FROM SpO2Measurements WHERE spo2 <= 90;

instruction: Your goal is to find prescription-related information for patients of a specific age group. Specifically, you want to know the top five medications prescribed to elderly patients. If multiple results tie for the same rank among the top frequent ranks, you want to retrieve all of them. You want to count each specific medication name only once per patient, and you want to define elderly as patients aged 65 and older. If the database contains age information at the time of admission, you want to use that information directly rather than calculating the age.
gold_sql: WITH patient_medications AS ( SELECT DISTINCT mo.patientid, mo.medicationname FROM medicationorders mo JOIN hospitaladmissions ha ON mo.admissionid = ha.admissionid WHERE ha.age >= 65 ), medication_counts AS ( SELECT medicationname, COUNT(*) AS prescription_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM patient_medications GROUP BY medicationname ) SELECT medicationname FROM medication_counts WHERE rank <= 5 ORDER BY rank;

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to microbiology tests. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10021312 and want to know the name of the microbiology test that was newly performed during the patient’s most recent hospital admission compared to their previous hospital admissions.
gold_sql: WITH LatestAdmission AS ( SELECT admissionid, admitdatetime FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10021312 ORDER BY admitdatetime DESC LIMIT 1 ), PriorAdmissions AS ( SELECT admissionid FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10021312 AND admitdatetime < (SELECT admitdatetime FROM LatestAdmission) ), PriorTests AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.testname FROM microbiologyresults m JOIN PriorAdmissions pa ON m.admissionid = pa.admissionid WHERE m.testname IS NOT NULL ), NewTests AS ( SELECT DISTINCT m.testname FROM microbiologyresults m JOIN LatestAdmission la ON m.admissionid = la.admissionid WHERE m.testname IS NOT NULL AND m.testname NOT IN (SELECT testname FROM PriorTests) ) SELECT testname FROM NewTests;

instruction: Your goal is to find statistics related to patient procedures. Specifically, you want to know the combined share of the five most frequently performed procedures among all procedures performed during hospital admissions. If multiple results tie for the same rank among the top frequent ranks, you want to include all of them in the calculation. You want the result in percentage (%).
gold_sql: WITH ProcedureCounts AS ( SELECT pc.description AS procedure_name, COUNT(*) AS procedure_count FROM admissionprocedures ap JOIN procedurecodes pc ON ap.icdcode = pc.icdcode AND ap.codeversion = pc.codeversion GROUP BY pc.description ), TopProcedures AS ( SELECT procedure_name, procedure_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY procedure_count DESC) AS rank FROM ProcedureCounts ), Top5Procedures AS ( SELECT SUM(procedure_count) AS top5_count FROM TopProcedures WHERE rank <= 5 ), TotalProcedures AS ( SELECT SUM(procedure_count) AS total_count FROM ProcedureCounts ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT top5_count FROM Top5Procedures) / (SELECT total_count FROM TotalProcedures), 4);

instruction: Your goal is to find statistics related to patient discharges. Specifically, you want to know the three most common hospital discharge locations. If multiple results tie for the same rank among the top frequent ranks, you want to retrieve all of them. Once you obtain the results, you want to narrow down the result to discharge records from the past 180 days.
gold_sql: WITH DischargeCounts AS ( SELECT dischargedestination, COUNT(*) AS discharge_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE dischargedestination IS NOT NULL AND datetime(dischargedatetime) >= datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', '-180 days') GROUP BY dischargedestination ) SELECT dischargedestination FROM DischargeCounts WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank;

instruction: Your goal is to find patient statistics related to input events. Specifically, you want to know the admissionid for patients whose daily total administered norepinephrine volume during a hospital admission exceeds the average by at least 50%. You want to treat multiple records for the same patient as independent cases. You want the norepinephrine data from patient input records, not prescription records.
gold_sql: WITH NorepiAdmin AS ( SELECT i.patientid, i.admissionid, date(i.startdatetime) AS admin_date, SUM(i.totalvolume) AS daily_amount FROM intakerecords i JOIN clinicalitemtypes d ON i.itemcode = d.itemcode WHERE lower(d.itemname) LIKE '%norepinephrine%' AND i.totalvolume IS NOT NULL AND i.totalvolume > 0 GROUP BY i.patientid, i.admissionid, admin_date ), AvgDailyAmount AS ( SELECT AVG(daily_amount) AS avg_daily_amount FROM NorepiAdmin ) SELECT DISTINCT admissionid FROM NorepiAdmin WHERE daily_amount >= (SELECT avg_daily_amount FROM AvgDailyAmount) * 1.5;

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to a patient's output records. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10018081 and want to know the total urine output over the past 24 hours. When searching for urine output, you want to use the keywords 'foley' or 'or urine'.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.volume) FROM outputrecords o JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON o.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE o.patientid = 10018081 AND (cit.itemname = 'foley' OR cit.itemname = 'or urine') AND datetime(o.recordeddatetime) >= datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', '-24 hours');

instruction: Your goal is to find statistics related to patient lab tests. Specifically, you want to know what percentage of the total lab tests performed in the hospital over the past 90 days is accounted for by the top five most frequently conducted lab tests. If multiple results tie for the same rank among the top frequent ranks, you want to retrieve all of them. You want the result in percentage (%).
gold_sql: WITH LabTestCounts AS ( SELECT lt.itemname AS test_name, COUNT(*) AS test_count FROM labresults lr JOIN labtesttypes lt ON lr.itemcode = lt.itemcode JOIN hospitaladmissions ha ON lr.admissionid = ha.admissionid WHERE datetime(lr.resultdatetime) >= datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', '-90 days') GROUP BY lt.itemname ), TopTests AS ( SELECT test_name, test_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY test_count DESC) AS test_rank FROM LabTestCounts ), Top5Tests AS ( SELECT SUM(test_count) AS top5_count FROM TopTests WHERE test_rank <= 5 ), TotalTests AS ( SELECT SUM(test_count) AS total_count FROM LabTestCounts ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT top5_count FROM Top5Tests) / (SELECT total_count FROM TotalTests), 4);

instruction: Your goal is to find patients prescribed certain medications. Specifically, you want patients prescribed atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, or simvastatin. If relevant patient records exist, request the number of patients prescribed any of these medications at least once this month.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mo.patientid) AS patient_count FROM medicationorders mo WHERE mo.medicationname IN ('atorvastatin', 'rosuvastatin calcium', 'simvastatin') AND datetime(mo.startdatetime, 'start of month') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of month');

instruction: Your goal is to find diagnoses with high mortality rates. Specifically, you want to identify the top 3 diagnoses with the highest mortality rates for patients admitted in the past year. Even if a patient is diagnosed with the same disease multiple times, treat each diagnosis as an independent event. Consider any patient with no death record to be a survivor. If multiple results tie for the same rank among the top frequent ranks, you want to retrieve all of them.
gold_sql: WITH MortalityRates AS ( SELECT dc.description, COUNT(*) AS total_diagnoses, COUNT(CASE WHEN d.dateofdeath IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS death_count, (COUNT(CASE WHEN d.dateofdeath IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS death_rate, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY (COUNT(CASE WHEN d.dateofdeath IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) DESC ) AS rank FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN demographics d ON ad.patientid = d.patientid JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion JOIN hospitaladmissions ha ON ad.admissionid = ha.admissionid WHERE ha.admitdatetime >= datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', '-1 year') GROUP BY ad.icdcode, dc.description ) SELECT description FROM MortalityRates WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank;

instruction: Your goal is to find statistics related to diagnoses upon readmission. Specifically, you want to know the most common diagnosis received by patients readmitted within 30 days of hospital discharge that matches the diagnosis from their previous admission. If multiple results tie for the highest frequency, you want to retrieve all of them. If a patient has multiple readmissions within 30 days, you want to count each diagnosis only once per patient.
gold_sql: WITH DiagnosesTemp AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ad.patientid, ad.admissionid, ad.icdcode, ad.codeversion, dc.description, ha.admitdatetime, ha.dischargedatetime, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY ad.patientid ORDER BY ha.admitdatetime ) AS admission_rank FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion JOIN hospitaladmissions ha ON ad.admissionid = ha.admissionid ), Readmissions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a2.patientid, a1.admissionid AS prev_admissionid, a2.admissionid AS next_admissionid, a2.icdcode, a2.codeversion, a2.description FROM DiagnosesTemp a1 JOIN DiagnosesTemp a2 ON a1.patientid = a2.patientid AND a2.admission_rank = a1.admission_rank + 1 AND datetime(a2.admitdatetime) BETWEEN datetime(a1.dischargedatetime) AND datetime(a1.dischargedatetime, '+30 days') WHERE (a2.icdcode, a2.codeversion) IN ( SELECT a3.icdcode, a3.codeversion FROM DiagnosesTemp a3 WHERE a3.admissionid = a1.admissionid ) ), DiagnosisCounts AS ( SELECT icdcode, codeversion, description, COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS patient_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) DESC ) AS rank FROM Readmissions GROUP BY icdcode, codeversion, description ) SELECT description FROM DiagnosisCounts WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY rank;

instruction: Your goal is to find statistics related to medication orders for patients who underwent a specific surgery. You are interested in CABG, and you want to know the top three medications prescribed within the same hospital admission record as the surgery. Since the database may include prescription start dates before the surgery, you want to focus on prescriptions within the same hospital admission as the surgery. If multiple results tie for the same rank among the top frequent ranks, you want to retrieve all of them. If a patient has multiple records of CABG across hospital admissions, you only want the first CABG record among them. If a patient has multiple records of the same diagnosis name, you want to count them only once per hospital admission.
gold_sql: WITH cabg_codes AS ( SELECT codeversion, icdcode FROM procedurecodes WHERE description IN ( 'single internal mammary-coronary artery bypass', '(aorto)coronary bypass of four or more coronary arteries', '(aorto)coronary bypass of three coronary arteries', '(aorto)coronary bypass of two coronary arteries', 'bypass coronary artery, one artery from left internal mammary, open approach', 'bypass coronary artery, one artery from left internal mammary with autologous arterial tissue, open approach', 'bypass coronary artery, one artery from aorta with autologous venous tissue, open approach', 'bypass coronary artery, one artery from right internal mammary with autologous arterial tissue, open approach', 'bypass coronary artery, three arteries from aorta with autologous venous tissue, open approach' ) ), FirstCabg AS ( SELECT p.patientid, p.admissionid, p.recordeddatetime, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.patientid ORDER BY p.recordeddatetime ) AS rn FROM admissionprocedures p JOIN cabg_codes c ON p.icdcode = c.icdcode AND p.codeversion = c.codeversion ), SelectedAdmissions AS ( SELECT patientid, admissionid FROM FirstCabg WHERE rn = 1 ), UniquePrescriptions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.admissionid, p.medicationname FROM medicationorders p JOIN SelectedAdmissions sa ON p.admissionid = sa.admissionid ), DrugCounts AS ( SELECT medicationname AS drug, COUNT(*) AS prescription_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM UniquePrescriptions GROUP BY medicationname ) SELECT drug FROM DrugCounts WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank;

instruction: Your goal is to find patient vital sign information. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10004733 and want to know their maximum heart rate during yesterday and today.
gold_sql: WITH HeartRateEvents AS ( SELECT ce.patientid, ce.recordeddatetime, ce.value AS heart_rate FROM clinicalevents ce JOIN clinicalitemtypes cit ON ce.itemcode = cit.itemcode WHERE cit.itemname = 'heart rate' AND ce.patientid = 10004733 AND ce.value IS NOT NULL AND (datetime(ce.recordeddatetime, 'start of day') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of day', '-1 day') OR datetime(ce.recordeddatetime, 'start of day') = datetime('2100-12-31 23:59:00', 'start of day')) ) SELECT MAX(heart_rate) AS max_heart_rate FROM HeartRateEvents;

instruction: Your goal is to find statistics related to procedures following a specific diagnosis. Specifically, you are interested in various types of acute kidney failure and want to know the top 3 procedures performed during the same hospital admission. If multiple results tie for the same rank among the top frequent ranks, you want to retrieve all of them. If a patient has multiple records of acute kidney failure across hospital admissions, you only want the first acute kidney failure record among them. If a patient has multiple records of the same procedure name, you want to count them only once per hospital admission. You want diagnosis names containing "acute kidney failure."
gold_sql: WITH FirstATNDiagnosis AS ( SELECT ad.patientid, ad.admissionid, ad.recordeddatetime AS first_atn_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ad.patientid ORDER BY ad.recordeddatetime) AS rn FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion WHERE dc.description LIKE '%acute kidney failure%' ), FirstATNPatients AS ( SELECT patientid, admissionid FROM FirstATNDiagnosis WHERE rn = 1 ), UniqueProcedures AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ap.patientid, ap.admissionid, pc.description AS procedure_title FROM admissionprocedures ap JOIN procedurecodes pc ON ap.icdcode = pc.icdcode AND ap.codeversion = pc.codeversion JOIN FirstATNPatients fap ON ap.admissionid = fap.admissionid ), ProcedureCounts AS ( SELECT procedure_title, COUNT(*) AS procedure_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank FROM UniqueProcedures GROUP BY procedure_title ) SELECT procedure_title FROM ProcedureCounts WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank;

instruction: Your goal is to find diagnostic statistics related to readmissions. Specifically, you want to know the most common new diagnosis, different from the previous admission, among patients readmitted within 30 days of hospital discharge. If multiple results tie for the highest frequency, you want to retrieve all of them. If a patient has multiple readmissions within 30 days, you want to count each diagnosis only once per patient.
gold_sql: WITH PatientAdmissionDiagnoses AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ad.patientid, ad.admissionid, ad.icdcode, ad.codeversion, dc.description, ha.admitdatetime, ha.dischargedatetime, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY ad.patientid ORDER BY ha.admitdatetime ) AS admission_rank FROM admissiondiagnoses ad JOIN diagnosiscodes dc ON ad.icdcode = dc.icdcode AND ad.codeversion = dc.codeversion JOIN hospitaladmissions ha ON ad.admissionid = ha.admissionid ), Readmissions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a2.patientid, a1.admissionid AS prev_admissionid, a2.admissionid AS next_admissionid, a2.icdcode, a2.codeversion, a2.description FROM PatientAdmissionDiagnoses a1 JOIN PatientAdmissionDiagnoses a2 ON a1.patientid = a2.patientid AND a2.admission_rank = a1.admission_rank + 1 AND datetime(a2.admitdatetime) BETWEEN datetime(a1.dischargedatetime) AND datetime(a1.dischargedatetime, '+30 days') WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PatientAdmissionDiagnoses a3 WHERE a3.admissionid = a1.admissionid AND a3.icdcode = a2.icdcode AND a3.codeversion = a2.codeversion ) ), DiagnosisCounts AS ( SELECT icdcode, codeversion, description, COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) AS patient_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT patientid) DESC ) AS rank FROM Readmissions GROUP BY icdcode, codeversion, description ) SELECT description FROM DiagnosisCounts WHERE rank = 1 ORDER BY rank;

instruction: Your goal is to find information related to a patient's hospital admission records. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10021487 and want to know how many days the patient has been admitted to the hospital.
gold_sql: WITH CurrentAdmission AS ( SELECT admissionid, admitdatetime FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10021487 AND dischargedatetime IS NULL ORDER BY admitdatetime DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT ROUND(JULIANDAY('2100-12-31 23:59:00') - JULIANDAY(admitdatetime), 4) AS days_admitted FROM CurrentAdmission;

instruction: Your goal is to find changes in a patient's lab test results. Specifically, you are interested in patient ID 10021938, and you want to calculate the difference between the first and last recorded creatinine values (last - first) during their latest hospital admission. You specifically want the creatinine level, not urinary creatinine.
gold_sql: WITH LatestAdmission AS ( SELECT admissionid, admitdatetime FROM hospitaladmissions WHERE patientid = 10021938 AND dischargedatetime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY admitdatetime DESC LIMIT 1 ), CreatinineTests AS ( SELECT lr.resultvalue, lr.resultdatetime, lr.resultunit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lr.resultdatetime) AS rn_asc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lr.resultdatetime DESC) AS rn_desc FROM labresults lr JOIN labtesttypes lt ON lr.itemcode = lt.itemcode JOIN LatestAdmission la ON lr.admissionid = la.admissionid WHERE lr.patientid = 10021938 AND lt.itemname = 'creatinine' AND lr.resultvalue IS NOT NULL AND lr.resultvalue > 0 ) SELECT ROUND(last_val - first_val, 4) AS creatinine_difference FROM ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN resultvalue END) AS first_val, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN resultvalue END) AS last_val FROM CreatinineTests ) t;

instruction: Your goal is to find cost-related information for patients meeting specific criteria. Specifically, you want to know the average total cost incurred during the hospital stay for patients transferred to the CVICU. If a patient visited the CVICU multiple times, you want to include only the hospital stay associated with their first CVICU visit in the results.
gold_sql: WITH FirstCVICUTransfer AS ( SELECT pt.patientid, pt.admissionid, pt.transferindatetime AS first_transfer_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.patientid ORDER BY pt.transferindatetime) AS rn FROM patienttransfers pt WHERE pt.careunit = 'cardiac vascular intensive care unit (cvicu)' ), FirstCVICUAdmission AS ( SELECT patientid, admissionid FROM FirstCVICUTransfer WHERE rn = 1 ), AdmissionCosts AS ( SELECT f.patientid, f.admissionid, SUM(cr.costamount) AS total_cost FROM FirstCVICUAdmission f JOIN costrecords cr ON cr.admissionid = f.admissionid GROUP BY f.admissionid ) SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_cost), 4) AS average_cost FROM AdmissionCosts;
